dct_title_s: Map of West River Bank, showing desired acquisition between Washington & Franklin Avenues, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map indicating Mississippi riverfront property the Board of Park Commissioners wished to acquire in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The map is found in the Twenty-seventh Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 104.
